name: All-Over Print AirPods Case
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality PC material, offering a lightweight, durable, and practical cover for everyday use.
    - Designed as a 2-piece protective case, including a top cover and a bottom cover for a snug and secure fit.
    - The top cover fits over the lid and snaps on easily to stay securely in place.
    - The bottom cover slides smoothly onto the case body for stable daily protection.
    - Built to help protect your AirPods charging case from scratches, bumps, and everyday wear.
    - Features a clean, compact design that keeps your AirPods case stylish while maintaining convenient portability.

 

  • Model Compatibility:
    - Available for multiple AirPods models:
                +) AirPods Gen 1
                +) AirPods Gen 2
                +) AirPods Gen 3
                +) AirPods Gen 4
                +) AirPods Pro 1
                +) AirPods Pro 2
                +) AirPods Pro 3
    📌 Note: Please select your correct AirPods model before checkout to ensure a precise fit.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality all-over heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - The full-surface heat transfer process allows the design to cover the case beautifully with a bright, clear, and eye-catching finished look.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a protective AirPods case cover and a personalized accessory.
    Designed for daily protection against scratches, bumps, and normal wear.
    Includes a precise cutout for the charging port to maintain convenient charging access.
    Easy to install with a two-piece design for quick attachment and removal.
    Lightweight and compact, making it convenient for everyday carrying in bags, backpacks, or pockets.
    Perfect for adding personality and style to your AirPods case while keeping it protected.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for friends, family members, coworkers, students, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, graduations, holidays, back-to-school gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who uses AirPods and enjoys customized tech accessories.
    - Great for gifting to daughters, sons, sisters, brothers, friends, classmates, and coworkers.
    - A meaningful gift that combines function, style, and personal expression.
    - Adds a fun, stylish, and memorable touch to everyday tech essentials 🎁

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
